description: Cases a PTY core must pass to serve protocol version 1. crates/paneflow-host/tests/conformance.rs runs every case against a real core over its real endpoint; a case listed here with no runner is a failure, not a skip.

cases.summary: host.hello answers with the core identity: name, protocol, host_instance, engine, pid, home and endpoint.
session.list returns every manifest the core knows, each carrying host_protocol_version and host_build_id.
session.output streams the session's output tail from the requested offset and ends with an explicit end frame.
session.input writes bytes to the session's PTY and the written bytes come back through the output tail.
session.resize applies new cols and rows and the manifest records them.
agent.snapshot lists every session with its raw last hook record and never with a reduced activity state.
agent.event naming a runtime_generation below the manifest's is refused, logged and not persisted.
